summary: Tested class editing end to end against the public URL. The initial implementation had a JSX closing-tag compile error; this in-scope typo was corrected and the Cancel control received a data-testid. All five requested behaviors then passed: every class card had an edit button, all five current values were pre-filled, Save issued PUT 200 and updated the list, and Cancel discarded changes. Backend focused tests passed 4/5; whitespace-only names are accepted and render as blank class cards.

minor.issue: PUT accepts a whitespace-only name and persists it with HTTP 200. Required-field validation should trim and reject blank name/grade/section values.

ui_bugs.issue: A whitespace-only name passes the client truthiness check, saves successfully, and leaves the class card with no visible name.
The icon-only edit button has no aria-label, title, or aria-labelledby value, so it has no accessible name.
Opening the dialog emits Radix accessibility warnings because DialogContent has no DialogDescription/aria-describedby configuration.

integration_issues.issue: Frontend and backend both accept whitespace-only required values; PUT returns 200 and the classes list renders a blank name.

action_items: Trim and reject whitespace-only class name, grade, and section in both handleUpdateClass and the backend Pydantic model.
Give each icon-only edit button an accessible label such as aria-label='Edit <class name>'.
Add DialogDescription or an explicit aria-describedby configuration to the Edit Class dialog.
Use process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL instead of window.location.origin for Classes.js API configuration.
critical_code_review_comments: Classes.js line 20 builds API URLs from window.location.origin, contrary to the required REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL deployment contract.
Client validation checks only JavaScript truthiness and ClassCreate uses unconstrained str fields, so whitespace-only required values pass both layers.
Classes.js is about 896 lines, above the 700-line maintainability limit; extract class dialogs/cards and student/portal sections into focused components.
The class update authorization condition allows any admin role to update a class from another school if its class_id is known; scope non-super-admin access by school_id.

success_rate.frontend: 83% (all 5 requested behaviors passed; whitespace validation failed as an additional edge case)

seed_data_creation: Backend pytest created four TEST_ classes and removed each in fixture teardown. Browser testing created two transient TEST_ teachers/classes; classes were deleted through the API and both users/schools were removed directly after testing. No test data remains.
test_credentials: The supplied test@school.edu credentials authenticate, but /classes redirects that account to pricing because its trial is expired. End-to-end feature verification used transient teacher accounts, which were fully cleaned up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Core class editing is working after removal of the extra closing div at the class-card markup and addition of data-testid='edit-class-cancel'. Re-test whitespace validation and accessibility after fixes. The focused command is: pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v -k 'class_update'.
rca_of_the_issue: The blank-name defect is caused by handleUpdateClass checking !editingClass.name without trimming and by ClassCreate declaring plain str fields with no strip/min-length constraint. The accessibility defects come from an icon-only Button without an accessible label and DialogContent without a DialogDescription.
